content.short: MythX is an EVM smart contract security analysis tool.
content.description: MythX is an EVM-focused security analysis tool that scans code to detect vulnerabilities in smart contracts. It integrates with common IDEs like Remix and can be used alongside Truffle to strengthen your security pipeline before, as, and after deploying contracts on EVM networks. The service lets you adjust the severity and depth of analyses and employs fuzzing to surface Solidity vulnerabilities before they reach production, helping teams ship safer code.
